parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The identifier (IDC) of the CoDi QR whose transactions you want to retrieve

parameters.name: nextToken
parameters.description: Pagination token returned by a previous request. Omit it to retrieve the first page

items.description: Up to 20 transactions of the CoDi QR, newest first

amount.description: Total amount of the transaction in MXN (Mexican Peso)

fee.description: Fee amount charged to the payer

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code of the transaction

paymentMethod.description: Payment method used for the transaction

description.description: Concept of the CoDi QR that was paid

applicationFee.description: Application fee charged on the transaction, if any

dateCreated.description: Unix timestamp when the transaction was created

datePaid.description: Unix timestamp when the transaction was paid (only present once paid)

metadata.description: Additional information about the transaction. The fields present depend on the payment method and the flow used. See [Metadata Response](../types/metadata-response.md).

nextToken.description: Token to retrieve the next page of transactions. It is null when there are no more transactions
